# Version 4.152.4
> **Failed flush cache cleanup** · Released October 12, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.204/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.4 prevents reuse of uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Discard failed-flush cache entries** — Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after unsuccessful rendering so later draws cannot reuse those entries' uninitialized textures. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.204

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
